definitions.explanation: The act of being mindful of others' feelings, circumstances, or needs and acting accordingly.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}りへの{配慮|はいりょ}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
ご{配慮|はいりょ}いただきありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for your kind consideration.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}に{配慮|はいりょ}した{製品|せいひん}を{作|つく}る。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{配|はい} (distribute, arrange) + {慮|りょ} (consideration, thought)

USAGE PATTERNS:
・〜に{配慮|はいりょ}する - to be considerate of ~
・〜への{配慮|はいりょ} - consideration for ~
・ご{配慮|はいりょ} - (your) consideration (honorific)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{環境|かんきょう}への{配慮|はいりょ} - environmental consideration
・{安全|あんぜん}への{配慮|はいりょ} - safety considerations
・{配慮|はいりょ}に{欠|か}ける - to lack consideration

RELATED:
・{思|おも}いやり - compassion, thoughtfulness
・{気遣|きづか}い - concern, solicitude
・{心遣|こころづか}い - thoughtfulness
